body.p: Ashby Rovers Under-16s finished the season in second place, their best result in twelve years. The team won 14 of their 20 matches and scored 52 goals. Captain Amira Hussain says the secret was simple: "We trained hard, and we looked after each other."
Trials for next season take place on the first Saturday in June at Ashby Park. Players aged 13 to 15 are welcome, and no experience is needed. Please bring shin pads and a water bottle.

ul: Trials start at 10:00 and finish at 12:00.
Boots are essential. Trainers are not allowed on the pitch.
Parents can watch from the café, which is open all morning.

body.p: Many fans think Ashby Rovers play the most exciting football in the county. Coach Mr Delaney is more careful: "We have a young squad, so there is still a lot of work to do."

questions.why: The text says the team "scored 52 goals". Fourteen is the number of matches won, and 20 is the number played.

writing.title: Is football too expensive?
writing.context: A local sports website has a forum thread called "Is football too expensive?". Readers are sharing their views.
writing.purpose: To give and explain your view.
writing.instruction: Write a post for the forum.
bullets: your view on whether football is too expensive
reasons and examples to support your view
indicative: View: yes, no, or it depends. Say it in the first sentence.
Reasons with examples: ticket prices, boots and kits, subs for a team, free alternatives such as park games. End by inviting replies.
